meaning: The potsherd — knowledge, experience, and what is kept from the past
note: From “Kyemfere se odaa ho akye, na onipa a onwenee no nso nye den?”: the potsherd says it is old — what then of the potter who moulded it?
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
